mapper.select: SELECT id, album_id, user_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at FROM review WHERE album_id = #{albumId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (album_id, user_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{albumId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET rating = #{rating}, comment = #{comment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(rating) FROM review WHERE album_id = #{albumId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE album_id = #{albumId}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rating >= 4) / COUNT(*))::int END FROM review WHERE album_id = #{albumId}

SELECT r.id, r.album_id, u.username, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM review r JOIN app_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.album_id = #{albumId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
